purpose: SIM_ONLY opt-in low-latency ONNX graph feature-layout A/B on eight fixed development first-touch courses
simulator: Isaac Sim 6.0.1 / Isaac Lab / PhysX, eight independent 8 m lanes, 300 x 20 ms control frames
dataset_contract: rolling 0.11 m ball; x=2.4/2.6 m, y=+/-0.1 m, vx=+/-0.5 m/s; no real hardware
single_changed_variable: G1 multi-frame orientation starts at ONNX graph input index 590 instead of legacy 584
promotion_rules: No promotion from this diagnostic A/B
Fresh remains sealed until a learned candidate is frozen and passes development/retention gates
stop_rules: Abort on nonfinite state, lane escape, invalid sensor shape or pelvis below 0.65 m
Do not count repeated frames as independent courses
